svg.text: Selected B / refined crown / pixel cut / light, dark and forest backgrounds / no application screens
These are screen minima, not print proofs. For crowded / low-quality contexts choose a larger size.
All logo SVGs: outlined paths, no fonts, images, strokes, masks or filters. Test sheets may use labels / diagnostic overlays.
Reference review is limited visual research, not trademark clearance. No real-device or physical print sign-off is implied.
